headline: Dasa Shares Drop 14% After UBS BB Downgrades Stock Amid High Interest Rates
summary: Dasa shares fell 14% after UBS BB cut its recommendation, citing financial pressure and a higher cost of capital caused by high interest rates.
why: Analyst downgrades, especially those highlighting debt service pressures in high-rate environments, can trigger sharp downward re-pricings in heavily leveraged equities.

impacts.name: Dasa
impacts.why: UBS BB downgrade and interest rate pressures triggered a 14% stock decline.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: A broker downgrade combined with concerns over elevated interest rates inflating the company's cost of capital led investors to sell off shares.
